name: agency-agents
description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
one_liner: A library of pre-written AI 'employee' personalities, a frontend developer, a marketer, a copywriter and more, that you load into your coding assistant so it acts like a small specialized team.
buyer: A solo freelancer or one-person 'agency' who takes on client work needing multiple skill sets (design, copy, marketing) but can't afford to hire a real team.
business_use_cases: A solo freelance developer uses the marketing and copywriting personas to deliver a client's landing page plus its launch copy and social posts, work that used to require subcontracting.
A small agency owner standardizes which 'agent' handles which task across projects, so junior staff get consistent, senior-level guidance baked into the AI's instructions.
An indie SaaS founder uses the 'reality checker' and 'whimsy injector' personas to get second-opinion style feedback on product decisions without hiring consultants.

money_ideas.idea: Package a curated subset of these personas as a paid 'virtual agency starter kit' for solo freelancers, sold once with lifetime updates.
Offer a done-for-you setup service: install and tune the right agent roster for a specific freelancer's niche, like Shopify stores or local service businesses.

steal_this: This weekend, pick three personas relevant to one real client project, run the work through them, and advertise the output as 'full-service' delivery from a one-person operation.
